name: amazon-mcp
description: Amazon (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders. Every tool

platform_mcp_amazon_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_amazon_client_id.description: LWA client identifier of your SP-API application (Developer Central / Solution Provider Portal > app > LWA credentials).

platform_mcp_amazon_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_amazon_client_secret.description: LWA client secret of the same application.

platform_mcp_amazon_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_amazon_refresh_token.description: LWA refresh token (Atzr|...) from self-authorising the app for your seller account (or from the seller's OAuth authorization); exchanged at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token for 1-hour access tokens sent as x-amz-access-token.

platform_mcp_amazon_region.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_REGION
platform_mcp_amazon_region.description: SP-API endpoint region: na (Canada, US, Mexico, Brazil), eu (Europe, UK, India, Middle East, Turkey, South Africa) or fe (Japan, Australia, Singapore); calls go to https://sellingpartnerapi-<region>.amazon.com.

platform_mcp_amazon_seller_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_SELLER_ID
platform_mcp_amazon_seller_id.description: Selling partner (merchant token) id used in the Listings Items path /listings/2021-08-01/items/{sellerId}/{sku} (Seller Central > Settings > Account Info > Merchant Token).

platform_mcp_amazon_marketplace_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_MARKETPLACE_ID
platform_mcp_amazon_marketplace_id.description: Marketplace id the tools act on, e.g. ATVPDKIKX0DER (US) or A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK); see the SP-API Marketplace IDs page.

platform_mcp_amazon_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_amazon_currency.description: Currency of the marketplace's offers (e.g. USD, GBP, EUR); needed only when update_listing changes the price (purchasable_offer selector).

platform_mcp_amazon_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ENV
platform_mcp_amazon_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://sandbox.sellingpartnerapi-{region}.amazon.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_amazon_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_amazon_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /sellers/v1/marketplaceParticipations returns {payload: [{marketplace{id, countryCode, name, defaultCurrencyCode}, participation{isParticipating, hasSuspendedListings}}]} — the marketplaces the seller can sell in.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PATCH /listings/2021-08-01/items/{sellerId}/{sku}?marketplaceIds (listing_id = your SKU) with productType PRODUCT and two JSON-Patch `merge` operations as in the Manage purchasable offer / Merge a listing guides: /attributes/purchasable_offer [{marketplace_id, currency, audience: ALL, our_price[{schedule[{value_with_tax: price}]}]}] and /attributes/fulfillment_availability [{fulfillment_channel_code: DEFAULT, quantity}]; a merge leaves omitted sub-attributes unchanged. `currency` comes from the config field. `title`/`description` (item_name / product_description need language_tag per marketplace) are not changed. Returns {sku, status ACCEPTED|INVALID|VALID, submissionId, issues[]}; processing is asynchronous.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: DELETE /listings/2021-08-01/items/{sellerId}/{sku}?marketplaceIds deletes the listings item for that marketplace (irreversible; listing_id = your SKU). Returns {sku, status ACCEPTED|INVALID, submissionId, issues[]}.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: PATCH /listings/2021-08-01/items/{sellerId}/{sku} with a `merge` on /attributes/fulfillment_availability [{fulfillment_channel_code: DEFAULT, quantity}] (Merge a listing guide) sets seller-fulfilled (MFN) quantity without touching restock_date / lead time. `sku` (or listing_id, which is the SKU on Amazon) addresses the listing. FBA stock is Amazon's and cannot be set.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /orders/v0/orders?MarketplaceIds&CreatedAfter(ISO-8601)&OrderStatuses(Pending|Unshipped|PartiallyShipped|Shipped|Canceled|Unfulfillable|...)&MaxResultsPerPage(1-100). `since` is REQUIRED in practice (Amazon: either CreatedAfter or LastUpdatedAfter must be set). Only the first page is returned: Amazon paginates with NextToken (raw payload.NextToken), not page numbers, so `page` > 1 repeats page 1. Rate 0.0167 req/s, burst 20. OrderTotal.Amount is a decimal string. Orders v0 getOrders is marked deprecated in favour of Orders v2026-01-01 searchOrders.
